breakdown.description: At the inlet, the specified phase volume fractions do not sum to 1 (e.g., alpha.air is set to 1.0 while alpha.catalyst is nonzero), which over-constrains the Euler–Euler phase fraction fields.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the phase volume fractions must sum to 1. It explicitly instructed to set alpha.catalyst to 0.01 and alpha.air to 0.99 at the inlet, ensuring their sum is exactly 1. This directly resolves the over-constrained condition from the original request.
